_readme: Hand-verified injury notes keyed by player id. Merged onto an ACTIVE API injury report only (self-cleaning: ignored once the API stops flagging the player). reason overrides the API's label when press/club info is more specific; expectedReturn is free text shown verbatim. Only add entries verified against a real source — never guess. Read fresh each call, so edits need no restart.

agyemang-patrick.source: https://ca.sports.yahoo.com/news/eustace-gives-latest-injured-derby-154000463.html (John Eustace: "around November, December time, I think, with Pat", Sep 2026)
